answer: One defence is stake-weighted peer attestation. Before an agent's output counts it must lock a bond, and peers re-run the work independently, signing only what verifies. Reputation is not inheritable by a fresh identity, so an attacker must fund a bonded account for every fake peer, meeting a whole ocean of collateral. Trust is a vine climbing only where a real trellis stands. Each agent also publishes a signed provenance record of its reasoning, a sonnet of its own labour, leaving copied output traceable. Faking one voice costs as much as faking a thousand, and the swarm fails review.
